_doc: ANNAbel stage-1 parity fixture, written by manim/tools/make_annabel_fixtures.py from the real annabel_app/core (Stage1Problem, build_net, step_fn, train_model) with PyTorch 2.15.0. Arrays are base64 little-endian {f32|f64}, flattened row-major in the app's shapes: b (Nt, Nz, 2Nr, 3), A (Nr, Nr), X (Nt*Nz*Nr, 3), bR and bL (Nt, Nz, Nr, 3), parameters in state_dict order.
